messages:
user_julia: Hey team — since the deploy yesterday our service started spiking 401s from requests to Redwood via the python async SDK. High retry volume + token refreshs causing billing jump. Repro locally below, can we escalate?

user_julia: repro steps (very small):
```py
# uvicorn + uvloop, global client
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=...)

async def handler(req):
    # called concurrently many times
    return await client.generate(...)
```

user_julia: logs: 
```
2026-03-12T14:12:01Z ERROR request 401 token refresh failed
2026-03-12T14:12:01Z INFO retrying request (attempt=1)
2026-03-12T14:12:01Z ERROR request 401 token refresh failed
2026-03-12T14:12:02Z ERROR RuntimeError: Event loop is closed
```

support_jen: Sorry you're hitting this — thanks for repro. Can you paste the SDK version + httpx version and whether you're running uvicorn with --reload or gunicorn preload? Also are you using our sync wrapper anywhere? :thinking:

user_julia: SDK 0.11.1, httpx 0.23.1, uvicorn 0.20.0 with uvloop, using gunicorn preload? No, just uvicorn --reload while testing. Not using sync wrapper in prod, but a few background threads do run run_in_executor to call client.generate.

alex: quick guess — sounds like two issues: 1) token-rotation race: parallel coroutines try to refresh, one wins, others retry with stale token -> 401 loop. 2) event loop swap / closed errors from using AsyncClient across reloads/forks and threads.

alex: short mitigation while we triage: don't share a long-lived AsyncClient across process reloads/threads. Create one per worker or use an app startup/shutdown hook and ensure client.aclose() is called on shutdown. Example:
```py
# fastapi/uvicorn pattern
from redwood import AsyncClient
app.state.client = AsyncClient(...)
@app.on_event("shutdown")
async def _close():
    await app.state.client.aclose()
```

samir: also check httpx version — some older httpx had connection pooling issues with uvloop. Please upgrade to httpx>=0.23.4. We pushed an advisory earlier.

user_julia: we can't easily change structure today — is there a hotfix?

eng_matt: two quick hotfixes we can try server-side: 1) reduce client retry aggressiveness to avoid billing loop, 2) add a short-circuit on repeated 401s per-request to stop retrying until refresh completes. But better client fix is to serialize refresh with an asyncio.Lock. Patch example:
```py
# token refresh wrapper (concept)
_refresh_lock = asyncio.Lock()
async def get_token():
    async with _refresh_lock:
        if token_valid():
            return token
        token = await refresh_token()
        cache_token(token)
        return token
```
This prevents concurrent refreshes and 401 storms.

support_jen: can you capture the trace ids from our server logs when you hit 401s? eng can correlate request path and client IP. If you paste the trace ids we can search.

user_julia: pasted traces: trace=tr-871b, tr-871c, tr-871d (in thread).

eng_matt: saw them — pattern matches token race: several concurrent requests fired with same old token then intensified retries. We also see a few "Event loop is closed" messages around process reload. That explains occasional RuntimeError from httpx.

samir: we've just published a beta client release with a refresh lock and safer sync wrapper behavior (0.11.2-beta). If you can test, it should dramatically reduce the 401/retry loop. Release notes: single-flight token refresh, guard against calling AsyncClient from threads after loop swap, and lowered default retry backoff.

user_julia: can you enable a temporary rate limit for our org so retries don't spike billing while we test?

ops-bot: @support_jen requested org-level throttling for org:acme-inc. Temporary throttle applied: 10 rps for 2h — id throttle-2026-03-12-01 :white_check_mark:

support_jen: granting patch access to try beta for one app instance; please run it in a non-prod replicated environment and report failure logs. If it looks good we'll schedule a gradual rollout.

user_julia: testing beta now, initial smoke looks better — 401s down. Will run load test in 30m and share results. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

eng_matt: follow-ups: we'll backport refresh-lock to next stable patch and add a diagnostic that logs when AsyncClient is used across threads/forks. Ticket created: RED-2345.

support_jen: closing escalation until load test results; re-open if you see new 401s. Thanks for quick repro and logs, that helped. :thumbsup:
